notes.title: Full game release - Version 1.0 changelog
notes.notes:
Full Game version of the game has been released! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144550/Bride_for_the_Princess/

We also have released Digital Artbook

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1429860/Bride_for_the_Princess__Digital_Artbook/?curator_clanid=37792130

You may also get them together on a Special Edition.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16263/

Changelog

Achievement 

New Achievement "Commence the Clowning", marry Clarimond
New Achievement "One for each day of the week", have six concubines and a wife

Bugfix

Asking Etsuko to come to the ruins on the second day caused her texture to change to Tephna's, this has been fixed
Tephna had wrong marriage pictures during her wedding, this has been changed
You could ask Ryia to marry you, even when you were already promised to another marriage, this has been fixed
You could ask Annabelle to marry you, even when you were already promised to another marriage, this has been fixed
You could ask Etsuko to marry you, even when you were already promised to another marriage, this has been fixed
Running away with Etsuko during the riot would always have the player called "Mary" during one sentence; regardless of the name actually used, this has been fixed
Wanting to marry Demoness without feeding Annabelle to her, would cause the trigger to marry her not to appear; this has been fixed
Fixed backlog messages corruption when exceeding message capacity
Fixed backlog messages appear in incorrect order when loading a saved game
Fixed save-load UI using wrong slot prototype for quick load grid
Fixed auto and skip modes retain after showing UIs, which block user input (backlog, save-load, settings, etc.)

CG

Golden Idol's picture is added to the CG gallery upon finding it

Gameplay

Added new dateable character Clarimond, the Battle Clown.
You can now have a harem by asking women to become your concubines, instead of just proposing to them.
Removed ability to call aid from Tephna, which didn't actually do anything
Ryia has a flavor text in the ending if you put her in jail or kept her around

Grammar

"How's thaT?" changed to "How's that?"
"I woudln't" changed to "I wouldn't"
"emotieneless" changed to "emotionless"
"Ask details" changed to "Ask for details"
"propper" changed to "proper"

Graphics

All the sex scenes have been redrawn from scratch
Marrying Ryia has a kissing picture at the wedding like other marriages

Localization

Added localization in Chinese

Marriage

We now see the chapel, while the priest talks. When invited; the couple comes forward to view for the ceremony and exchanging the vows

Lore 

New Lore Entry "Origin of Battle Clowns"

UI

Removed the Early Access bug reporting tool

Unity Version

Updated to 2019.4.13f1

notes.title: Full version of the game is releasing on 26th of October
notes.notes:
I'm happy to report that all the hard work is finally coming to a closure, an absolutely massive update will signal the change from Early Access to full version.  

Release date will  be 26th of October

We are also launching a digital artbook, which contains 11 pages worth of sketches, designs and illustrations that went to making the game. The digital artbook also contains all the early access version "bed scenes", since they have all been redrawn from scratch for the full release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1429860/Bride_for_the_Princess__Digital_Artbook/

We are also going to release a special deluxe version of the game which contains both the base game and the digital artbook.
